experiment: CIC-IDS2017 independent day-held-out binary classification; research-only; not Random Forest V2 evaluation

split.strategy: Monday through Thursday training; all three Friday files held out

configuration.imputation: median SimpleImputer fitted per model on training sample; keep_empty_features=True
configuration.test_sampling: none; all valid labeled Friday rows streamed

limitations: One collection day is held out; capture/session independence within that day is not asserted.
The experiment trains new CIC-IDS2017 models and does not evaluate or validate frozen Random Forest V2.
The local copies have per-file checksums, but no download receipt/source archive checksum was supplied.
The local Web Attack labels contain U+FFFD in the label text; binary mapping preserves the raw spelling in counts.
